en.headline: Diocesan Boys’ School to offer three university pathways from 2027
en.dek: The elite Direct Subsidy Scheme school plans to add the International Advanced Level curriculum alongside the DSE and IB Diploma, pending Education Bureau approval.
body: Diocesan Boys’ School announced on Saturday that it intends to offer the International Advanced Level curriculum from 2027, becoming the first school in Hong Kong to provide three distinct university pathways if the Education Bureau grants approval.

Headmaster Ronnie Cheng Kay-yen told a Primary One admission talk that the school has already obtained approval from Cambridge International Education and the Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority. Form Three students in the coming school year would be able to choose between the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education, the International Baccalaureate Diploma and the International Advanced Level.

Cheng said the school’s 1,400 secondary and 900 primary students have varied learning speeds and directions, and the additional pathway aims to match individual suitability while maintaining international competitiveness.

zh.headline: 拔萃男書院擬2027年起開辦三條升學路徑
zh.dek: 直資名校計劃新增國際高級程度會考課程，與文憑試及國際文憑並行，成為本港首間提供三條升學途徑的學校，尚待教育局批准。
body: 拔萃男書院校長鄭基恩周六在小一入學講座宣布，校方擬於2027年起開辦國際高級程度會考（IAL）課程，若獲教育局批准，將成為本港首間同時提供文憑試、國際文憑及IAL三條升學路徑的學校。
鄭基恩表示，校方已取得劍橋國際教育及香港考試及評核局批准，正等候教育局綠燈。來年中三學生將可選擇香港中學文憑、國際文憑或國際高級程度會考課程。
他指學校有約1,400名中學生及900名小學生，學習速度、能力及方向各有不同，新增路徑旨在讓學生找到合適模式，同時保持國際競爭力。
